_comment: Single source of truth for every worker. Geometry (batch, blockThreads, minBlocks, workers) must match the binary named by binaryKey and must never change while checkpoints exist: a checkpoint is only loadable into the same worker/batch shape. dpWeight must be identical campaign-wide or cross-worker collisions can be missed. maxIters restarts a walk that has not reported and discards its steps, so it must stay many mean trail lengths long: a trail averages 2^28.41 steps at dpWeight 32, and 2^32 cuts 0.0006% of honest trails where 2^30 cut 4.9% (15.6% of all steps; crypto/ecc2k130/WALK-CONSTANT.md section 6). build.sh fills in binaryKey/hostBinaryKey/sourceSha256.
